top_recommendation.title: Code-enforced global-only containment ceiling
top_recommendation.finding: decision_engine_lib.py can reach RECOMMEND_CONTAINMENT on a record with multi_source=False (pure global intel, zero local corroboration); the one real Phase C run had 11/74 RECOMMEND_CONTAINMENT records, 100% multi_source=False
top_recommendation.proposal: add an explicit guard capping max reachable action at ALERT_HUMAN when multi_source is False and no local telemetry module independently corroborates the same entity
top_recommendation.status: IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-14 (ARCHITECTURE.md Phase 104) -- decision_engine_lib.py's local_corroboration_for_profile() and containment_approval_lib.py's has_trusted_local_corroboration() both now gate on a dedicated LOCAL_SOURCE_MODULES allowlist (shadow_ai_monitor/attack_graph/saas_ato), not bare multi_source; real-data regression on the actual 74-record Phase C file shows RECOMMEND_CONTAINMENT dropping from 11 to 0. 51/47/118/66/38/46/23/54/185/31 tests passed (0 failed) across affected suites. ssh_exposure_monitor.sh remains unwired into the Intelligence Layer (not fixed by this phase).
